failure_reason: All six Runtime residents completed their pre-cycle work, but Runtime's low-disk continuity guard refused checkpoint advancement before signed dehydration. The retained Runtime volume contained both the active 12 GiB pinned S3 model store and its one-time 12 GiB conversion backup. The persistent volume has been expanded to 256 GiB; the repair removes that exact backup, grows the mounted filesystem, requires 10x model-store free capacity, and reuses the warm volume without a cold snapshot clone or full-store startup read.
